address: Burj Khalifa, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Boulevard, Dubai
bio: You’re guided to the lifts in the lobby of the Armani Hotel to get to the world’s highest restaurant, on the 122nd floor of the Burj Khalifa. The last refit provided a sumptuous lounge and muted tones in the restaurant, which are matched by the uniforms of the staff. The views are, of course, spectacular. The wide-ranging à la carte menu offers modern, colourful dishes with a French heart; the ingredients are equally top-drawer and include caviar and Wagyu steak. Tasting menus are also available at lunch and dinner....
